subject: general
question:
Saksham starts from point A and drives 71 km towards east. He then takes a left turn, drives 48 km, turns left and drives 81 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 89 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 10 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **Saksham starts from point A and drives 71 km towards east. He then takes a left turn, drives 48 km, turns left and drives 81 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 89 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 10 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4023182c95f6a33b0834f39cfe95aa48d9e02f5d98a18376cd5e2c7e72f89863.png] 

Thus, he should drive 41 km to the north to reach point A from point P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
